news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.60 loss per share (vs ₹0.65 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹2.60 loss per share (down from ₹0.65 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹686.2m (up 2.0% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹124.8m (down 499% from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 42% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 36% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: E-Land Apparel Limited Announces Resignation of Mr. Heegu Shin as Whole-Time Director, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: E-Land Apparel Limited announced that Mr. Heegu Shin (DIN: 10747987) has tendered his resignation from the position of Whole-time Director, with effect from the close of business hours on January 5, 2026, due to his preoccupation and certain personal commitments. The resignation letter was dated January 5, 2026 and received by the company on January 5, 2026.

news.title: E-Land Apparel Limited Announces Resignation of Mr. Heegu Shin as Chief Financial Officer, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: E-Land Apparel Limited announced that Mr. Heegu Shin (DIN: 10747987) has tendered his resignation from the position of Chief Financial Officer of the company, with effect from the close of business hours on January 5, 2026, due to his preoccupation and certain personal commitments. The resignation letter was dated January 5, 2026 and received by the company on January 5, 2026.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Less than 1 year of cash runway based on free cash flow trend (-₹296m free cash flow). news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹4.05 loss per share (vs ₹0.07 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹4.05 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.07 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹337.5m (down 24% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹194.4m (loss widened ₹191.0m from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 46% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 29% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
